thread:
FinanceOps: Heads up 1: nightly reconciliation found 428 orphan credit memos in NetSuite that don't map to any Stripe invoice. Report: /reports/billing/orphan_credits_2024-11-03.csv
Priya: Oof. Any common pattern? ext_id vs invoice_id mismatch?
Dan: Quick sample: NetSuite custom field 'external_ref' contains stripe:in_1JqXYZ but our importer expects stripe:inv_... The upstream job uses invoice.number for mapping sometimes and invoice.id other times.
Evan: Confirmed. The legacy ingestion used invoice['number'] when present (human readable) and invoice['id'] for programmatic links. Some older promo credits only have number.
AccountingBot: ALERT: orphan_credit_count > 100 in last 24h. Auto-created ticket #FIN-9876.
Priya: We need a guarded repair flow. Can't blind-reassign credits in NetSuite. Proposal: (1) generate candidate mappings using invoice_amount + customer + date window, (2) create CSV with confidence score, (3) manual approve >0.95 then auto-apply, lower confidence require review.
Dan: SQL I used to find likely matches: 
```
select c.id as credit_id, c.amount, ns.external_ref, s.customer_id, s.amount as stripe_amount, abs(c.amount - s.amount) as delta
from net_credits c
join stripe_events s on c.customer_id = s.customer_id and date_trunc('day', c.created_at) between s.created_at - interval '2 days' and s.created_at + interval '2 days'
where c.external_ref is not null and c.external_ref not like 'stripe:%';
```
Found 428 candidates.
Evan: Also found a bug in nightly-importer: when invoice.number is null, it writes external_ref = invoice.number (NULL) which later becomes empty string in NetSuite export, breaking reconciliation. Patch ready.
Priya: Can we run a dry-run of the candidate matcher and upload CSV to accounting for triage today? Need finance lead signoff.
FinanceOps: Yes. Please include columns: net_credit_id, ns_batch_id, candidate_stripe_invoice_id, confidence_score, reasons. I'll review after lunch.
Dan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/517 1 -- fixes importer null handling and adds a reconciliation dry-run export.
Priya: Also: we should surface these confidence scores in the Console so ops can triage faster. File ticket for product?
Evan: Filed FE-2134 to add a 'Reconciliation > Candidate Matches' view.
AccountingBot: Approved manual review workflow required by policy for >$5k credits. 3 approvals needed.
Priya: These are small credits mostly, but there's one vendor account with $6.2k. Flagged in CSV.
FinanceOps: Ops, plan: run dry-run now, collect CSV, do manual approve for high-confidence rows tonight 20:00 PT, schedule script to patch external_ref for confirmed matches, then trigger NetSuite update job. Anyone on-call at 20:00?
Dan: I'll be on-call.
Evan: I'll deploy the importer patch to staging and run the dry-run script against staging export first. deploy-bot: deploy started for canary/importer 2024-11-03T13:45Z :rocket:
Priya: One more ask: add a monitoring alert when orphan credit rate > 0.5% of daily credits.
FinanceOps: Added alert to PagerDuty policy billing-orphans-high.
Dan: After this, we should make mappings prefer stripe_event_id when present; that's the most reliable. Also add a unique index on stripe_event_id on credits table to prevent duplicates.
FinanceOps: Agreed. Action items: (1) dry-run CSV upload (Dan), (2) importer null handling hotfix (Evan -> PR 517), (3) FE ticket for Console view (Evan), (4) alert rule (FinanceOps). Keep updates here.
AccountingBot: CSV uploaded to ticket FIN-9876: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-9876?focusedCommentId=101
Priya: Reviewing CSV now. Will call out rows for manual approval.
FinanceOps: Great. We'll follow the manual approval path for anything >$1k. Smaller ones auto-apply if confidence >= 0.95.
Stripe-Webhook-Bot: note: stripe event retries for 2024-11-02 02:14-02:20 saw 12 retries due to upstream 502s. Potentially related.
Evan: Good catch. I'll correlate event timestamps with orphan credits to see overlap.
Dan: If everything looks good, schedule NetSuite update during maintenance window 22:00-22:30 PT.
FinanceOps: Approved. Postmortem ticket created to track root cause and follow-ups.
